ngaap.guidance: From 2024 base business core growth no longer reported or guided. Q1-24: core sales -high-single digit. FY2024: core sales -low-single digit. No EPS guidance.
ngaap.notes: Adjusted diluted EPS adds back pretax amortization of acquisition-related intangibles, fair value (gains) losses on equity and limited partnership investments, impairments and other charges, pension settlement losses, acquisition-related items, product-line disposition gains and contract settlement expense, then deducts the aggregate tax effect and removes discrete tax items. MCPS: per-share adjustments assume all MCPS converted ('if-converted' regardless of dilution); adjusted diluted shares = GAAP diluted shares + converted shares of anti-dilutive MCPS, and the related MCPS dividends are added back. Continuing operations only (Veralto excluded; separation costs now sit in discontinued operations). New items: Abcam acquisition-related items and litigation gain. Adjusted diluted shares = GAAP 746.1m. Item amounts from release footnotes.
